name: Kettlebell Single-Arm Swing
steps: Stand behind the kettlebell with feet just wider than shoulder width, hinge at your hips and grasp the handle with one hand.
Hike the kettlebell high between your legs, then snap your hips forward forcefully and squeeze your glutes to swing the bell forward to chest height.
Keep your working arm relaxed and straight while letting your free arm swing naturally in rhythm to resist torso twist.
Hinge as the bell comes back between your thighs, then guide it to the floor before switching arms.
tips: Keep both shoulders level and resist letting the single-sided weight pull your torso into rotation.
Drive the swing with a crisp hip hinge rather than squatting up and down or lifting with your arm.
